parseable.description: Configuration for the Parseable Helm release.

deploymentMode.description: standalone runs one OSS pod; distributed runs separate ingestor and querier pods and is required for Enterprise.

image.description: OSS container image used by standalone and distributed ingestor/querier pods when Enterprise is disabled.

repository.description: OSS image repository, for example quay.io/parseablehq/parseable.

tag.description: OSS image tag. An empty value uses the chart appVersion.

pullPolicy.description: Kubernetes image pull policy, for example IfNotPresent or Always.

imagePullSecrets.description: Names of existing Kubernetes Secrets used to pull the OSS image from a private registry.

store.description: Storage backend and the Secret holding Parseable admin and storage credentials.

type.description: Storage backend: local-store (standalone only), s3-store, gcs-store, or blob-store.

secretName.description: Existing Secret with admin username/password and the selected object-store settings.

gcsCredentials.description: GCS service-account key Secret; used only with gcs-store.

secretName.description: Existing Secret containing the GCS service-account JSON key.

secretKey.description: Field in the Secret holding the GCS key JSON.

mountPath.description: Directory where the GCS key is mounted in Parseable pods.

clusterSecret.description: Shared authentication secret for distributed nodes; required for Enterprise, optional for OSS, and unused in standalone mode.

enabled.description: Inject P_CLUSTER_SECRET into distributed nodes when true.

secretName.description: Name of the existing Kubernetes Secret containing the cluster secret.

secretKey.description: Field in that Secret containing the shared cluster value.

enterprise.description: Enterprise edition settings. Enable only with deploymentMode: distributed.

enabled.description: Use the Enterprise image and deploy Prism when true.

image.description: Container image used by Enterprise ingestor, querier, and Prism pods.

repository.description: Enterprise image repository, for example quay.io/parseablehq/parseable-enterprise.

tag.description: Enterprise image tag. An empty value uses the chart appVersion.

pullPolicy.description: Kubernetes image pull policy, for example Always or IfNotPresent.

license.description: Enterprise license data and signature loaded from Kubernetes Secrets at startup.

secretName.description: Existing Secret containing the Enterprise license JSON and, for file mode, its signature.

mountPath.description: Directory where the license files are mounted read-only inside each Enterprise pod.

dataKey.description: Filename/Secret field containing the license JSON data.

signature.description: How the Enterprise license signature is provided.

source.description: file reads the signature from license.secretName; base64 reads it from signature.base64.

key.description: Signature filename/Secret field when source is file.

base64.description: Secret reference for a base64-encoded signature when source is base64.

secretName.description: Existing Secret holding the base64 signature.

key.description: Field in that Secret containing the base64 signature.

datasets.description: Datasets managed by this release. Omit to leave datasets unchanged; use [] to delete all deletable user datasets.

items.description: One dataset and its optional tags, Smart Cache, and retention settings.

name.description: Unique dataset name. Use letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores; the name cannot be changed later.

telemetryType.description: Kind of telemetry stored in this dataset. Must match an OTel log source and cannot change after creation.

logSource.description: Incoming data format. otel-logs, otel-metrics, and otel-traces require the matching telemetryType. Cannot change after creation.

tags.description: Optional dataset tags. agent-observability requires telemetryType: traces and logSource: otel-traces.

smartCache.description: Enterprise-only Smart Cache for this dataset. The querier needs enough usable disk space for the requested size.

size.description: Cache size, for example 10Gi. Minimum 10Gi. Use 0Gi or "" to remove Smart Cache from an existing dataset.

retention.description: Dataset retention rule. Omit to leave the current rule unchanged.

durationDays.description: Keep data for 1d to 3650d, for example 30d. Use 0d or "" to remove retention.

apiKeys.description: API keys managed by this release. Omit to leave keys unchanged; use [] to revoke all API keys.

items.description: One named API key with a server-managed ingestor or all-datasets reader role.

name.description: Unique API key name. Use only letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores.

apiKeyType.description: Required. ingestor can ingest into all datasets; query gets the reader privilege on all datasets.

secretKeyRef.description: Optional Kubernetes Secret field containing a caller-supplied UUID v4 API key. Omit to generate a key for a new entry and print it once in Helm output.

name.description: Kubernetes Secret name in this release's namespace.

key.description: Field in the Secret containing this API key value.

ingestor.description: Nodes that receive and stage incoming events.

env.description: Environment variables passed to each ingestor container.

RUST_LOG.description: Rust log verbosity, for example warn or info.

resources.description: Kubernetes CPU and memory resources for each ingestor.

requests.description: CPU and memory reserved for scheduling each ingestor.

limits.description: Maximum CPU and memory allowed for each ingestor.

persistence.description: Local disk settings for each ingestor.

staging.description: Staging area for incoming events before object-store upload; uses a PVC when enabled, otherwise emptyDir.

enabled.description: Create a staging PVC for each ingestor when true.

storageClass.description: Kubernetes StorageClass for staging PVCs; empty uses the cluster default.

accessMode.description: Kubernetes PVC access mode, for example ReadWriteOnce.

size.description: Staging PVC size for each ingestor, for example 5Gi.

replicas.description: Number of querier pods. Enterprise can use multiple queriers behind Prism.

env.description: Environment variables passed to each querier container.

RUST_LOG.description: Rust log verbosity, for example warn or info.

resources.description: Kubernetes CPU and memory resources for each querier.

requests.description: CPU and memory reserved for scheduling each querier.

limits.description: Maximum CPU and memory allowed for each querier.

persistence.description: Local persistence for each distributed querier.

hotTier.description: Enterprise querier hot-tier disk. Each querier uses a PVC when enabled and emptyDir when disabled; ignored for OSS.

enabled.description: Create a persistent volume for each Enterprise querier's hot tier when true.

storageClass.description: Kubernetes StorageClass for the hot-tier PVC; an empty value uses the cluster default.

accessMode.description: Kubernetes access mode for the hot-tier PVC, for example ReadWriteOnce.

size.description: Requested hot-tier PVC size for each Enterprise querier, for example 50Gi.

prism.description: Enterprise Prism node settings for the UI and API entry point.

env.description: Environment variables passed to each Prism container.

RUST_LOG.description: Rust log verbosity, for example warn or info.

resources.description: Kubernetes CPU and memory resources for each Prism.

requests.description: CPU and memory reserved for scheduling each Prism.

limits.description: Maximum CPU and memory allowed for each Prism.

persistence.description: Optional persistent volume for Prism's own local state.

enabled.description: Create a PVC for Prism's local state when true.

storageClass.description: Kubernetes StorageClass for Prism's state PVC; empty uses the cluster default.

accessMode.description: Kubernetes access mode for Prism's state PVC, for example ReadWriteOnce.

size.description: Requested size of each Prism state PVC, for example 5Gi.

cache.description: Separate disk for Prism's PromQL results cache; uses a PVC when enabled and emptyDir otherwise.

enabled.description: Create a PVC for Prism's PromQL results cache when true.

storageClass.description: Kubernetes StorageClass for Prism's cache PVC; empty uses the cluster default.

accessMode.description: Kubernetes access mode for Prism's cache PVC, for example ReadWriteOnce.

size.description: Requested size of each Prism cache PVC, for example 5Gi.
